text:
maria-fin: FYI — nightly billing run created ~18 phantom invoices for 2025-02-14. Invoice IDs look like inv_ph_001 .. inv_ph_018. None map to Stripe charges; reconciliation job flagged source='webhook' and queued them for review.

ajay-eng: on it, digging into webhook consumer logs and proxy. any pattern on customer/plan?

devin-ops: are they all the same plan or random?

maria-fin: mostly 'team-monthly', some different customers. total impact ~ $12k. need a quick patch + cleanup before EOM.

ajay-eng: quick look — proxy returned 502/504 for a bunch of POSTs to /integrations/stripe/webhook around 02:03 UTC; our consumer retried but the upstream proxy strips the idempotency header so retries look like new events. i see entries where header X-Redwood-Event-Idempotency is missing.

ajay-eng: relevant log snippet:
```
[2025-02-14T02:03:12Z] POST /webhooks/stripe 502 proxied from 10.8.1.22
payload.event.id=evt_3KXabc...
headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "Stripe/1.0"} // idempotency header absent
```

stripe-bot: Stripe: event evt_3KXabc had 3 delivery attempts; 1st attempt 200, subsequent attempts returned 502 and 504 from our proxy.

nina-acct: we should not create invoices from webhook retries with no matching charge. Can we block invoice creation when there's no charge or when idempotency is missing?

ajay-eng: yes — plan: 1) hotfix consumer to fallback to event.id as idempotency key if header missing, and reject duplicate payloads; 2) add check that we only create invoice records when a matching Stripe charge exists (or mark for manual review).

devin-ops: rolling patch now to staging, will push to prod after smoke tests.

ajay-eng: patch diff (summary): fallback idempotency logic + additional pre-check on charge existence. committing as 9f2b7a3. deploy command: `tools/deploy --service=webhook-consumer --image=webhook-consumer:2.1.5-hotfix`

maria-fin: @tara-cfo can you sign off on deleting phantom invoices > $1k if cleanup finds them? accounting requires explicit approval for deletes.

tara-cfo: tara-cfo: approved to delete phantom invoices related to this incident (up to full set) — proceed.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: webhook-consumer -> 2.1.5-hotfix by ajay-eng at 02:45 UTC

deploy-bot: Deployment successful: webhook-consumer 2.1.4 -> 2.1.5-hotfix at 02:48 UTC

ajay-eng: starting dry-run cleanup script to identify phantom invoices: `scripts/cleanup_phantom_invoices --date 2025-02-14 --dry-run`

Dry-run output:
```
Found 18 candidate phantom invoices for 2025-02-14
 - 3 invoices can be matched to charges after a secondary lookup (relinkable)
 - 15 invoices have no matching charge and were created via webhook consumer without idempotency header
Total sum affected: $12,070
```

nina-acct: confirm we will only delete the 15 without matches and relink the 3? please keep detailed audit of deletes.

ajay-eng: yes. executing with `--delete --audit-log=/mnt/audit/phantom-delete-20250214.log` now. starting 03:00 UTC.

[~10m later]

ajay-eng: cleanup finished: 15 invoices deleted, 3 relinked. audit log: /mnt/audit/phantom-delete-20250214.log. Reconciliation re-run passes for that date.

maria-fin: thanks. nina, can you confirm accounting records look good post-cleanup?

nina-acct: recon run shows inventory: all matched, totals align with Stripe payouts. I'll file a short JIRA to note process change.

ajay-eng: PR for the hotfix: https://github.com/redwood/integration/pull/4567. runbook updated at https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/webhook-idempotency.md

maria-fin: action items summarized:
 - ajay-eng: hotfix deployed and PR merged (done)
 - ajay-eng/devin-ops: audit log + retention (done)
 - nina-acct: file JIRA & confirm ledger (done)
 - infra: review proxy config to ensure idempotency header passthrough (follow-up)

maria-fin: closing this thread; will monitor for 24h and escalate if repeats :eyes:
